product_metadata.title: Gianna's Home Rustic Farmhouse Desk 3 Drawer Wooden Vanity Makeup Beauty Jewelry Storage Organizer (Rustic White)
features: Rustic farmhouse style looks beautiful on your desk, dresser or vanity with a distressed gray/white shabby chic finish.
Place the beauty organizer on your dresser or vanity to store jewelry, hair accessories, makeup, and more. Can also be used on your desk to hold pens, notepads, paper clips and more.
Features 3 drawers, one large cubby in the center and six smaller cubbies on each side.
description: Accent your shabby chic decor with our 3 drawer vanity organizer! . It has individual cubbies that can be used to store jewelry, cosmetics and much more on your dresser or vanity. Can also be used as a handy desk organizer for office supplies, pens and notepads and more. Features a rustic distressed gray/white finish that will go perfectly with your rustic style in your bedroom or office. 15-7/8"W x 7-3/8"D x 4-3/4"H.
